acceptanceCriteria: the CRB-V0-017 exported-current proof uses the single in-tree checkout root and no code or doc reads CORVINT_PROOF_TASKS_ROOT
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from PR #233 follow-ups. After corvint-tasks moved in-tree (decision 0397), internal/companionrelease/exported_current_test.go still reads the retired CORVINT_PROOF_TASKS_ROOT separate-checkout root, so the CRB-V0-017 proof depends on an external checkout that no longer exists.
title: CRB-V0-017 exported-current proof still reads CORVINT_PROOF_TASKS_ROOT after the in-tree move
